spark_views._blur_note: one 224 px global view per image from the shared recipe; the authors use crop + flip only ('minimal augmentation'), so no blur

spark._densify_note: set explicitly: the authors' arg_util.py leaves it EMPTY (no normalisation) for any model name without 'resnet'/'convnext'
spark._recon_note: 1 = reconstruct the single SAR channel (A3 change); 3 = the authors' literal target, which here would include the per-channel ImageNet offsets (CHANGES.md)
spark._precision_note: true float32: TF32 is switched OFF for cudnn and matmul in SparKMethod.build (flags recorded in run output and the export)

optim._lr_note: peak lr = base_lr x batch_size / 256 = 5e-5 at the shared batch 64 (the authors' rule, arg_util.py L132; paper Section 4.1)
optim._beta2_note: set explicitly: arg_util.py leaves beta2 = 0.0 for any model name without 'resnet'/'convnext'
optim._warmup_note: the authors' 40 of 1,600 epochs = the first 2.5% of training; here 2.5 of the shared 100 epochs (linear from 0.005 x peak, then cosine to 0.001 x peak)
